name: planter
description: Delegate tasks to named tmux/cmux/herdr sessions: find or create the session, run claude, codex, or a plain shell, then monitor and report back; on herdr, also open an issue worktree in its own workspace

interface.longDescription: Delegate tasks from a Claude Code or Codex session to named tmux, cmux, or herdr sessions: find or create the session, run claude, codex, or a plain shell in it, monitor the screen, and report the result back. On herdr it also starts work: hand it a Jira or Linear issue and it opens a worktree in a new workspace named after the issue, with planner, worker, and reviewer panes waiting in the checkout.
defaultPrompt: Run the tests in the build session
Create a session called deploy and have claude fix the lint errors there
Start ABC-123 and open a worktree for it
